symptom: Changing a source attribute's Localize (`DateTime` -> `DateTime not localized`) with `alter entity … modify attribute` or `create or modify entity` leaves every view entity selecting it with the old LocalizeDate; `mxcli check`/`exec` are silent and `mx check` reports CE6770 "View Entity is out of sync with the OQL Query" once per view. A String length / kind / enumeration change on the source breaks a pass-through view column the same way
cause: A view column's LocalizeDate was derived from its source (viewDateTimeLocalize, #1297) only when the view statement itself ran; nothing on the source-entity write paths looked at the views reading it
file: mdl/executor/oql_view_resync.go (resyncViewsOverSource), called from execAlterEntity modify attribute and the create-or-modify branch of execCreateEntity in mdl/executor/cmd_entities.go
insight: A property derived from another document at write time goes stale when that other document changes: every derivation needs a re-derivation hook on the source's write paths, not only on the deriving statement's. Diff type signatures (kind, length, enum ref, localize) before/after the source write, resolve `alias.Attr` refs per view column through extractAliasMap, rewrite only a column whose derived value differs (repeat run writes nothing; a view not reading the changed attribute is the control), chain to views over the resynced view. What the view text declares (length, kind, enum) cannot be re-derived without rewriting the user's statement, so it is an exec-time warning naming view and column — check cannot see it because check never applies the source change.
